title: Extreme Q Glass Mouthpiece for 3′ Whip
description:
Upgrade your vaping experience with the Extreme Q Glass Mouthpiece for 3′ Whip. Expertly crafted for the V-Tower and Arizer Extreme Q vaporizers, this premium glass whip mouthpiece ensures a pure and flavorful vapor every time.

Whether you’re replacing an old whip or looking for interchangeable mouthpieces, this glass piece seamlessly fits the bill. Not only does it enhance your vapor’s taste, but its sturdy glass construction also promises longevity.

Dive into a world of smooth vaping with the Arizer Extreme Q glass whip mouthpiece, a must-have for every V-Tower vaporizer enthusiast.
